Vintage seed beads in consistent sizing are increasingly hard to source, and a sunny, clear yellow is a workhorse color that earns its place in any serious bead collection.

The transparent finish means light passes straight through the glass, giving the yellow a luminous, glassy glow rather than a flat or chalky look — more lemon-drop than mustard.

  • Material: Glass
  • Quantity: 50g

At 10/0, these work beautifully in loom weaving and off-loom stitches like peyote or brick stitch, where their transparency adds depth and dimension to geometric or floral patterns. They're also a natural choice for fringe, embroidery accents, or stringing projects where a pop of clear, airy color ties a palette together.
